title: A0 finite-mixing axial-vector benchmark: unchanged B.7 neutrinos plus UV-mixed exact-recoil B.13 moving-muon transport
status: A0 interior-profile transport diagnostic; outer 25--100 km semi-Compton opacity remains unavailable

model.charged_muon_current: A'_alpha mu_bar gamma^alpha (gV + gA gamma5) mu
model.muon_targets: mu_minus and mu_plus separately; charge-conjugated axial term retained before summing
model.dimuon_channel: closed for all requested masses below 2*m_mu=211.316751000 MeV
model.coupling_scan: g_X is scanned; gV/gX and gA/gX are fixed by theta_mu_R

transport.optical_depth: radial integral of reduced absorption Gamma_abs-Gamma_prod, mode by mode
transport.angular_escape_average: omitted to match the C1 radial prescription
transport.lapse_redshift: omitted to match the C1 comparison convention
transport.outer_neutrino_opacity: unchanged B.7 two-flavour vacuum decay width per mode
transport.outer_semicompton_opacity: omitted; no validated 25--100 km muon susceptibility profile

comparison_reference: The retained Croon Eq. (4.7) quantity in each mass record is the literal mu-minus-only pure-vector reference on the same grid. It is a diagnostic comparator, not part of the A0 source or opacity.

10.outer_opacity: B.7 two-flavour vacuum decay per mode from Rnu to Rfar=100 km; outer B.13 semi-Compton opacity is omitted because no validated 25--100 km muon-susceptibility profile is available

scope: The A0 calculation keeps the C1 B.7 neutrino rates unchanged and replaces only the charged-muon B.13 current by the original UV finite-mixing V-A current. It uses the reconstructed public SFHo-18.8 profile and does not include the unavailable outer 25--100 km semi-Compton opacity. It is not a final SN1987A exclusion curve.
